screen.rnd-block-placer.title: Random Block Placer
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.placement: Turns random placement on or off (same as the J key). When on, every block you place is picked at random from your selection.
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.not_a_block: Not a block, cannot be selected
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.click_add: Click to add to the selection
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.click_remove: Click to remove, Shift+click to set its chance
label.rnd-block-placer.selection.empty: No blocks selected. Click blocks in your inventory to add them.
hint.rnd-block-placer.edit_weight: Click a row or Shift+click a block to set its chance.
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.weight.confirm: Apply this chance (Enter). The other blocks share the rest and keep their proportions. 0 removes the block.
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.clear: Removes every block from the current selection. Your presets are not affected.
label.rnd-block-placer.preset.none: No presets yet. Type a name below and click Create to save the current selection.
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.preset.row: Click to select, double-click to load
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.preset.load: Replace the current selection with the selected preset
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.preset.update: Replace the blocks of the selected preset with the current selection
button.rnd-block-placer.preset.name: Preset name
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.preset.create: Save the current selection as a new preset
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.preset.create.n: Type a name for the new preset
A preset with this name already exists
options.rnd-block-placer.save_mode.descr: When the changes you make in the selection menu are saved. Hover the button for details.
options.rnd-block-placer.save_mode.on_cl: Changes in the selection screen are saved automatically when you close it.
options.rnd-block-placer.save_mode.manua: Changes are only saved when you click Apply. Closing the screen discards them.
options.rnd-block-placer.missing_block.d: What happens when a selected block runs out of your inventory.
options.rnd-block-placer.missing_block.c: Keep placing with the blocks you still have. You are warned once per missing block. Placement turns off only when none are left.
Keep placing with the blocks you still have, without any chat warning. You are still told when placement turns off because none are left.
options.rnd-block-placer.missing_block.d: Turn random placement off as soon as one selected block is missing.
options.rnd-block-placer.hud_position.de: Where the random placement indicator is shown while it is on.
options.rnd-block-placer.hud_position.to: Show the indicator at the top of the screen, centered.
Show the indicator in the top-left corner.
Show the indicator in the top-right corner.
options.rnd-block-placer.hud_position.ab: Show the indicator just above the hotbar.
message.rnd-block-placer.missing_materia: §c[RBP] Missing materials: §e%s§c. Random placement turned off.
message.rnd-block-placer.missing_continu: §6[RBP] Out of §e%s§6, continuing with the other blocks.
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.share.preset: Send the selected preset to other players. They need this mod to import it
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.share.selection: Send the current selection to other players. They need this mod to import it
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.share.copy: Copy the preset as a code to the clipboard. Paste it anywhere, then import it with the Import button of the Presets tab
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.preset.import: Add the preset whose code is in the clipboard
toast.rnd-block-placer.title: Random Block Placer
toast.rnd-block-placer.import_invalid: The clipboard does not hold a valid preset code
tooltip.rnd-block-placer.share.send_chat: Post the preset in public chat. Every player with this mod can import it, others see a code
chat.rnd-block-placer.share.import_missi: This preset was already imported or has expired.
chat.rnd-block-placer.share.import_empty: None of the blocks in this preset exist in your game.
chat.rnd-block-placer.share.invalid: Received a damaged preset that could not be read.
label.rnd-block-placer.wheel.no_presets: No presets yet. Create one in the selection screen (B).
